subject: Predeclared gates for arms P and Q, written BEFORE either was built or pushed. Follow-ups to arm K.
context: Arm K (LOCAL_ANALYZER_TOP_K 20 -> 100 at temperature 0.9) returned 44 levels against an incumbent 35 and a pooled 0.6/0.9 control mean of 32.3, with ONE zero-level game against 4 to 7, and it cleared tr87-cd924810, one of the two games no configuration had ever solved. That is the largest matched-commit result in this project's history. It is n=1 and needs confirmation.

q38-topk100-rerun-v1.change: NOTHING. Byte-identical rerun of arm K from the same source dataset.
q38-topk100-rerun-v1.purpose: Confirmation, and the only honest way to price arm K. Our instrument's arm-minus-control difference has sigma 5.1 to 6.1 levels, so a single +11.7 is z = 1.9 to 2.3, suggestive but not settled. This run also yields arm K's OWN paired per-game level-diff sd, which is the quantity the 2026-08-24 gate amendment requires before any variance claim can be made about a config.
q38-topk100-rerun-v1.what_it_would_falsify: If it returns at or below 35, arm K's 44 was substantially luck and the promotion rests on the zero-level count and the mean alone. If it returns 40 or above, top_k is the largest lever this project has found and the whole sampling-truncation axis deserves the remaining GPU.

q38-topk-unclamped-v1.change: LOCAL_ANALYZER_TOP_K 100 -> -1 (truncation disabled) at temperature 0.9. Single variable against arm K.
q38-topk-unclamped-v1.hypothesis: top_k = 20 is Qwen's recommended value and it was a HARD CAP on what temperature could do: at 20 candidates a raised temperature only reshapes probability inside the same 20 tokens. Relaxing it to 100 apparently moved +11.7 levels and cut zero-level games from 4-7 to 1, which is a breadth effect consistent with the model finally being able to explore. The dose question is whether 100 is still binding. -1 removes truncation entirely and leaves top_p = 0.95 as the only nucleus control, which is the clean limit of the same mechanism. This is NOT a small dose point: the previous step on this axis was worth an order of magnitude more than any sampling change we have tested.
PROMOTE_requires_all_of: paired sign test against arm K shows gained - lost >= 4
REJECT_if_any_of: malformed tool calls at a materially higher rate than arm K
q38-topk-unclamped-v1.INCONCLUSIVE_band: 36 to 43 levels. Ties go to the INCUMBENT (arm K), per the 2026-08-24 amendment. There is no variance tiebreak.
q38-topk-unclamped-v1.prediction_recorded_in_advance: I expect 36 to 44, i.e. inconclusive, because top_p = 0.95 probably already truncates below 100 candidates on most steps, which would make 100 and -1 nearly the same sampler. If that is right, arm K's value comes from escaping 20, not from the exact ceiling, and 100 should ship.

shared_preconditions: All 25 games run and hold their full 7,920s slot.
Peak GPU KV cache usage strictly below 0.90.
KV cache size 398,272 tokens (confirms fp8 KV is live).
gate_rules_summary: Ties go to the incumbent. No variance tiebreak.
Gate on the paired per-game sign test, not the level total.
REJECT only on confidently negative evidence; a false promote is nearly free because the board keeps our maximum.
